title: astragalus consentaneus
intro: Astragalus consentaneus, commonly known as the Astragalus, is a type of plant in the legume family that has been used in traditional Chinese medicine for centuries. The health benefits of Astragalus include its ability to enhance immune function, reduce inflammation, and improve cardiovascular health. The therapeutic actions of Astragalus include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and immunomodulatory effects, which contribute to its use in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Astragalus include flavonoids, saponins, and polysaccharides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
